title: Mean under dual bribery
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and let $J$ be a set of coordinates. The mean of the function obtained by first replacing the coordinates in $J$ by $1$ and then applying the dual of $f$ equals the negative of the mean obtained by replacing the coordinates in $J$ by $-1$ and applying $f$.
